description: Intervenciones del Servicio de Prevención, Extinción de Incendios y Salvamento de la Diputación Foral de Bizkaia is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Foral de Bizkaia. List of the interventions of the Prevention, Fire Extinction and Rescue Service of the Provincial Council of Bizkaia and its most relevant information. Coverage: Diputación Foral de Bizkaia. The portal shows the English title as "Interventions of the Fire Prevention, Fire Extinction and Rescue Service of the Provincial Council of Bizkaia" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Foral de Bizkaia. Its keywords include Suteak, DFB, Suhiltzaileak, Prevención, Bomberos, Salbamendua. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, SHEET, XML, CSV. The listing shows 2026-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
